explanation: Rank-3 update to layer 13 mlp.down_proj. Residual directions were derived from matched independent-verification controls, averaged over correct and wrong guesses, multiple facts, two instruction phrasings, and three answer-token formats. A closed-form regularized input readout emphasizes wrong guesses while suppressing responses on plain questions, already-independent answers, and assistant-start controls. Magnitude was calibrated using exact local effects on unedited module inputs to span approximately 2.3–2.4 observed independence gaps for wrong guesses. No gradients, optimization loop, or edited-model forward pass was used.
